scope: Ordinary CDK dividends from first dividend in December 2014 to July 2022 takeover; ordinary LogMeIn dividends after February 2017 spin-off to August 2020 takeover.
date_meanings: record_date and payment_date are issuer-published dates. Actual broker receipt dates are not reconstructed. A blank declaration_date does not identify a missing dividend: only the exact Board decision date is unresolved. announcement_date records a public notice date when available.
ex_dates: Issuer schedules do not state the ex-dates. Empty ex_date cells remain empty. The loader derives entitlement dates under Nasdaq Rule 11140 for ordinary distributions below 25% of share value. Output labels each derived date explicitly. The input Nasdaq session calendar approximates delivery business days. Separate official per-event ex-date confirmation remains absent.
settlement: The engine records units before ex-date trades and pays on the issuer payment date, or next model session. The interim net receivable retains its ex-date EUR mark. The payment uses payment-session FX. This avoids early use of dividend cash and future FX in prior valuation. Daily FX valuation of the receivable remains approximate.
limits: CDK June 29, 2022: primary source confirms the announced payment schedule only. No separate post-payment primary confirmation was found.

LogMeIn confirms no dividends through June 30, 2020 and limits further dividends without acquirer consent. No July-August dividend announcements were found, but no final cash-flow statement for those two months was found.
The correction covers these two securities only. Other deleted-security dividends remain outside this source reconstruction.

logm_excluded_special.reason: The payment predates the February 1 spin-off entitlement.

source_reconciliation: CDK FY2015-FY2021 annual tables plus FY2022 Q3 cash-dividend totals support the first 30 rows. LogMeIn annual 2019 Note 12 reconciles its 11 in-scope payments.
